column2: [intro]
Sitting in my corner, meditating alone,
My worries pile up endlessly,
Nothing makes sense, everything is so strange.
One day I laugh, the next day tears fall randomly.
I get lost in my thoughts, you know,
Thinking it's cheap, it's never fun,
Life is sometimes so badly arranged,
Don't try to understand, let me derail.
People look at me with lost eyes,
They find my problems quite ridiculous,
But I care about my offbeat stories,
It's my niche, my way of staying connected.
I try to keep smiling, you know,
But sometimes in my head everything tears apart,
It's a sad song, drowned in the cheap,
Don't try to understand, let me wallow in my deliciously creepy sorrow.
[ solo ]
So I sing my strange melody,
With incomprehensible and foggy choruses,
It's so chee-e-e-e-e-e-e-ep,
Don't try to understand, come dance with me in this world without bearings.
[ outro ]
